name: green-zone-cross-below-mitigated
note: The EQL mirror of green-zone-cross-above-mitigated: Pine sweeps an equal-low zone on `low < sweepLevel`, where sweepLevel is the zone BOTTOM. Bars 1-2 hold above the bottom edge (low 10.5, 10.2 > bottom 10) and leave the zone live; bar 3 (low 9.5) takes it out, so cross_below fires and the zone closes mitigated. Paired with the cross_above case so the mitigation rule is pinned on BOTH directional predicates, not just the one the ICT port happens to use first.
source:
indicator("H", shorttitle="H", overlay=true)
plotzone(bar_index == 0, high, low, "EQL", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.cross_below, mitigated_color=color.gray)
